page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2.13xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor. It features 56 dedicated physical cores and 56 vCPUs running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz, with a single thread per core configuration. The system is equipped with 224.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. This instance does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core performance. Single-core tests, such as stress-ng and Geekbench single-core, place the server in the bottom 25%, with single-threaded gzip compression falling into the bottom 10%. However, the high core count compensates in parallel workloads, where multi-core stress-ng, Geekbench multi-core, and PassMark CPU scores consistently reach average tiers. Memory bandwidth tests show stable throughput, measuring 104.7 GB/sec for large block read-only operations and 50.68 GB/sec for write operations.

Given its balanced resource profile, the ecs.sn2.13xlarge is categorized as a general-purpose instance. It is well-suited for multi-threaded applications, static web serving, and database operations, as reflected in its average PassMark database and Redis SET performance. While single-threaded tasks and complex real-time LLM text generation represent performance bottlenecks, the dedicated CPU allocation provides predictable compute density for parallelized enterprise workloads and software compilation.
